title: Doraemon (1979)
justification: TVDB 252696 splits the 1979 series into one season per year, 27 seasons and 1787 episodes, whose absolute numbers equal AniDB's episode numbers, mostly with the same date: 1 to 235 are season 1, 236 Something's Gonna Occur at 7 o'clock is season 2 episode 1, 492 Sunrise Set is season 3 episode 1, 1777 Flag of Truth is season 26 episode 38 The Banner of Truth, 1787 Doraemon Takes a Day Off is season 27 episode 10. With no rows, AniDB 236-1787 fell past season 1's end; one row per year season places them. The specials defaulted onto the films at season 0 episodes 1-39; by title they are season 0 episodes 53-83: S1 Fishing Pond in My Room = 53 The Fishing Pond in My Study Room (1979-10-03), S4 The Uncle and Elephant = 56, S9 Nessie Appears! = 61 Nessie's Coming!, S12 Come Back, Doraemon = 64, S23 Nobita no Gulliver Ryokou = 75 Nobita's Gulliver Travels, S30 the 30th anniversary special = 83, and S32 Early English With Doraemon = 41; the others have no TVDB episode.
